title: The Symmetry of Differential Neural Tangent Kernel under the Orthogonal Group
abstract: arXiv:2610.34023v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The differential neural tangent kernel (DNTK) is a tool for analyzing the training dynamics of overparameterized physics informed neural networks. In this work, we investigate the symmetry of the infinite DNTK under an orthogonal group, for two layer and deep neural networks separately, based on the explicit expression of the DNTK and recursive formula, respectively. The results are for all activations with or without a bias term, and shed insight into the structure of the infinite width DNTK. Then we prove that the integral operators over the unit sphere induced by operators from the same group orbit share the spectrum, and their reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces differ only by an orthogonal transformation, and that the operator fixed DNTK exhibits zonal symmetry on the unit sphere for symmetric operators. Thus the eigenvalue decay rate of the associated integral operator can be derived for shallow networks with RePU activation and zero

translated_title: 正交群下微分神经正切核的对称性
translated_abstract: 微分神经正切核（DNTK）是分析过参数化物理信息神经网络训练动力学的工具。在本工作中，我们分别针对两层神经网络和深度神经网络，基于DNTK的显式表达式和递归公式，研究了无穷维DNTK在正交群作用下的对称性。所得结果适用于所有带或不带偏置项的激活函数，并为无穷宽度DNTK的结构提供了深入洞见。随后我们证明了：由同一群轨道上的算子所诱导的单位球面上的积分算子共享相同的谱，且它们的再生核希尔伯特空间仅相差一个正交变换；此外，对于对称算子，算子固定的DNTK在单位球面上表现出区域性（zonal）对称性。由此，对于采用RePU激活函数和零……（原文在此截断）的浅层网络，可以推导出相关积分算子的特征值衰减率。
tldr: 本文研究了无穷宽度微分神经正切核在正交群作用下的对称性，证明同一群轨道诱导的积分算子共享谱且其再生核希尔伯特空间仅相差正交变换，从而为RePU激活浅层网络的积分算子特征值衰减率分析提供了理论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates the symmetry of the infinite-width differential neural tangent kernel under the orthogonal group, proving that integral operators induced by operators from the same group orbit share the spectrum and their reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces differ only by an orthogonal transformation, which enables the derivation of eigenvalue decay rates for shallow RePU networks.
